text_block_list.text:
Summer camp was approaching its midpoint.
Although Buena Vista's training was
progressing smoothly—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah...
One more lap... please...!
choice_data_list: No good, let's take a break for now.
No, let's take a break for now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No! I want to train more!
Please...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
............Understood.

She's leaning too far forward with her emotions
and constantly pushing herself into a corner. As I thought,
it's dangerous to leave things as they are.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes.
choice_data_list: Shall we head to Hokkaido now?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah...—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~ !?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san, Trainer-san!
—Welcome to Hokkaido♪"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I-I really came...!

To match Special Week's trip back home,
I asked if I could join her for just the first few days,
and she gladly agreed.
choice_data_list: Thanks for helping me out, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
Right back at you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "I'm just so happy to be able to show Buena-san around my beloved hometown♪"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Look... you know Buena-san
admires someone like me,
right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I really do think of you as a special junior, you know!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Please enjoy Hokkaido to your heart's content
over the next few days!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san......
...Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Still, is this really okay?
Playing around instead of training...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, all our rivals are growing stronger... and in the Shuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
Y-You think so...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ah.
Scratch marks...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Could this boiling feeling
in my chest be from that too...?"
choice_data_list: Right. Let's let all of that go for once.

text_block_list.text:
Among her generation, Buena Vista's ability is
leaps and bounds ahead. Even against Senior-class girls,
she would win... I have complete confidence in saying that.

"Then what she needs right now...
is to bring out her full potential.
To do that, what we must adjust is her mental balance."
choice_data_list: Having as much fun as possible is the training this time.
Having a blast is what this training is all about!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
...But.
choice_data_list: Do you not like the menu I came up with?
Don't you like the training menu I came up with?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Jeez!
It's not fair when you say it like that."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You two, the train's coming soon~!
Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! First off is Sapporo... and when it comes to Umamusume, you've gotta talk about Sapporo Racecourse, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The racetrack...
A race...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: Spe hasn't run in a Sapporo race, right?
Spe hasn't run in a Sapporo race, has she?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yep, there aren't any! So to be honest,
it's more that I just wanted to go myself...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but please don't worry!
I've gathered plenty of info in advance!
Apparently, there's a lovely terrace upstairs!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
! ...What a beautiful terrace...
...I wonder how far we can see from here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes, surely all the way across the sea!
Let's eat soft serve ice cream when we get there♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—The view from the terrace
was so very wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Being able to look out all the way to the distant mountains...
It really refreshed my mind.
...So, what about this?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
At this zoo,
you can see animals living in near-natural habitats!
I'm sure a wonderful view awaits us♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Also, apparently their melon soft serve
is super delicious...!
Let's go check it out!
choice_data_list: Didn't you just eat soft serve earlier?!
Didn't you just eat soft serve earlier?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san, wait for me!
I'll have the same thing!

Thanks to Special Week,
Buena Vista's heart gradually...
and steadily began to open up—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
As for what to do after this...
Actually, I couldn't decide~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
There's a mountain stream over there,
but it looks like quite a walk.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "In that case, maybe I'll go on a little gourmet food tour around here for a bit♪"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
What would you like to do, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I'm gonna give this food tour my all!
A long walk to the mountain stream.

text_block_list.text:
"Sapporo brings together all kinds of gourmet foods from across Hokkaido.
It might be great for building power while getting refreshed."
choice_data_list: Let's eat to our hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice spirit!
Trainer-san, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"When you think of Sapporo, you think of miso ramen, right?♪
Ehehe, I can't wait~."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: After that, Jingisukan, zangi, and soup curry... That sounds about right for half a day, doesn't it? ♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, you can't eat that much, can you?
You don't have to force yourself."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Let's split everything in half as much as we can so we can try all kinds of foods!

And so, in high spirits,
our brief, multi-day trip to Hokkaido continued—

Summers in Hokkaido aren't as hot and humid as on the main island.
With this climate, walking around a lot
shouldn't be too much of a hardship.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then,
let's give it our all and push on!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...
It's so cool and refreshing...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It feels like we might just
forget that it's summer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, this soothing feeling is so incredible...
It feels like I might forget everything else...

text_block_list.name: Spe & Buena
text_block_list.text: Daaaze...

And so, in high spirits,
our brief, multi-day trip to Hokkaido continued—

The final day arrived before we knew it.
As for Buena Vista—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!
How vast...!
choice_data_list: It feels like the view suddenly opened right up in front of me.
It feels like the view suddenly opened right up in front of me, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Haaah... what a lovely view...

Having successfully discharged all that pent-up energy,
Buena Vista was back to her usual gentle self.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"There are a lot of ranches
around here, aren't there?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup!
My home is a ranch too, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That's right...! Spe-san's roots are right here...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Every time I take a deep breath,
it feels like all the air in my body is being replaced.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You grew up in such a lovely place, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
That's why before important races, I always end up wanting to go home.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the Japan Cup was like that too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It was the Japan Cup
that you both watched.
choice_data_list: I had no idea... you went back home.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Just for a few hours, though!
Before I take on the world, I just really needed to breathe in the air of my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Being called 'Japan's Supreme Commander'...
Having everyone place their hopes on me...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was feeling a little prickly.
But looking at this relaxing view...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...All the thorns in my heart
just completely melt away, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
—I hope Buena-san feels the same way.

I didn't explain the situation to Special Week
this time. She had finally gone home, and I
didn't want to make her worry unnecessarily.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I've gained a lot of experience through racing, too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "I understand what it means to take even a few days off at a critical time like this."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a deep breath,
Buena-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Take a deep breath of the fresh air
and the scenery...
and let the wind flow through your heart!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"If you do that, I'm sure
you'll feel totally refreshed and ready for a clean start!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: (...I'm so glad Spe was here with me.)

text_block_list.text:
Special Week drew close to Buena Vista, standing shoulder to shoulder.
Seeing her back, I was reminded once again of just how great she is—
